The correct order of total number of atoms present in
(A) 2 moles of cyclohexane
(B) 684 g of sucrose
(C) 90.8 L of dihydrogen at STP
is :
questions.solution:
(A) 2 moles of cyclohexane ($\mathrm{C_6H_{12}}$)
No of atoms $= 18 \times 2 \times N_A$
(B) Mole of sucrose $= \frac{684}{342} = 2$
No of atoms $= 2 \times 45 \times N_A = 90N_A$
(C) Mole $= 90.8/22.4 = 4$

B > A > C

questions.stem:
The species having identical radii according to the Bohr's theory are :
A. H (first orbit)
B. $\mathrm{He^{+}}$ (first orbit)
C. $\mathrm{He^{+}}$ (Second orbit)
D. $\mathrm{Li^{2+}}$ (first orbit)
E. $\mathrm{Be^{3+}}$ (Second orbit)
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
Radius of $n^{th}$ orbit $= 0.529\ \text{Å}\ \frac{n^{2}}{Z} = a_0 \frac{n^{2}}{Z}$
(A) $r = a_0\left[\frac{1^{2}}{1}\right] = a_0$
(B) $r = a_0\left[\frac{1^{2}}{2}\right] = \frac{a_0}{2}$
(C) $r = a_0\left[\frac{2^{2}}{2}\right] = 2a_0$
(D) $r = a_0\left[\frac{2^{2}}{3}\right] = \frac{4a_0}{3}$
(E) $r = a_0\left[\frac{2^{2}}{4}\right] = a_0$

questions.stem: 20 mL of a solution of acetic acid required 28.4 mL of 0.1 M NaOH for its neutralization. A solution (X) was prepared by mixing 20 mL of the above acetic acid and 14.2 mL of 0.1 M NaOH solution. What is the pH of the solution (X) ? ($\mathrm{p}K_a$ value of acetic acid is 4.75).
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{CH_3COOH + NaOH \rightarrow CH_3COO^{-}Na^{+} + H_2O}$
In the experiment 1, 28.4 ml is required for complete neutralization therefore for 14.2 ml half equivalence point will be achieved to form acidic buffer.
pH $=$ pKa of $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ $+ \log$ [Salt/acid]
pH $=$ pKa $= 4.75$

questions.stem:
If 3.365g of ehtanol ($l$) is burnt completely in a bomb calorimeter at 298.15 K, the heat produced is 99.472 kJ. The $|\Delta H_f^\circ|$ of ethanol at 298.15 K is $\underline{\qquad\qquad}$ $\times 10^{2}\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$. (Nearest integer)
Given : Standard enthalpy of combustion of graphite $= -393.5\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$.
Standard enthalpy of formation of water ($l$) $= -285.8\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
Molar mass in $\mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$ of C, H, O are 12, 1 and 16 respectively.
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}(l) + 3\mathrm{O_2}(g) \rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO_2}(g) + 3\mathrm{HO}(l)$
$\frac{3.365}{46} = 0.073$
Heat liberated by combustion of 1 mole $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}$
$= \frac{99.472}{0.073} = 1362.63\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$
$\Delta H^{0}_{rx^{n}} = -1362.63\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$
$(\Delta H_c)^{0}_{\text{Graphite}} = (\Delta H_f)^{\circ} \cdot f\ \mathrm{CO_2}$
$\Delta H^{0}_{R_{x^{n}}} = 2\left[\Delta H_{f_{\mathrm{CO_2}}}\right] + 3(\Delta H_f)_{\mathrm{H_2O}} - (\Delta H_f^{0})_{\mathrm{CH_2OH}}$
$-1362.63 = 2(-393.5) + 3(-285.8) - \Delta H_f^{0}$
$(\Delta H_f^{\circ})\,\mathrm{C_2H_5OH} = 281.77\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$
$= 2.81 \times 10^{2}\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$
$= 3 \times 10^{2}\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$

$^\circ\mathrm{C} + 273 = \mathrm{K}$
questions.solution:

Let 1 mole

questions.stem:
An electrochemical cell, consist of the following two redox couples, $\mathrm{M^{x+}(aq)/M(s)}$ $[E^{\ominus}_{red} = +0.15\ \mathrm{V}]$ and $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}(aq)/Fe(s)}$ $[E^{\ominus}_{red} = -0.036\ \mathrm{V}]$. The cell EMF ($E_{cell}$) is recorded to be 0.2057 V. If the reaction quotient of the electrochemical reaction is found to be $10^{-2}$, then the value of x is $\underline{\qquad\qquad}$. (Nearest integer)
[Given : M is a p-block metal and $\frac{2.303RT}{F} = 0.059\ \mathrm{V}$]
questions.solution:
Anode : $\mathrm{Fe(s) \rightarrow Fe^{+3}(aq) + 3e^{-}}$
Cathode : $\mathrm{M^{+x}(aq) + xe^{-} \rightarrow M(s)}$
$\mathrm{3M^{+x} + xFe(s) \rightarrow 3M(s) + xFe^{+3}}$
$E^\circ_{cell} = 0.15 + 0.036 = 0.186\ \mathrm{V}$
$E_{cell} = E^\circ_{cell} - \frac{0.059}{3x}\log 10^{-2}$, $0.2057 = 0.186 - \frac{0.059}{3x}(-2)$
$0.0197 = +\frac{0.118}{3x}$
$X = 2$

questions.stem:
For a first order reaction $\mathrm{A \rightarrow B}$
$t$/min | [A]/M
0 | 0.6500
x | 0.0650
20 | 0.00065
x = $\underline{\qquad\qquad}$ min. (Nearest integer)
questions.solution:
1st order $rx^{n}$
$\ln\frac{A_0}{A_t} = kt$
$\ln\left(\frac{0.6500}{0.00065}\right) = k \times 20$
$k = \frac{3\ln 10}{20}$
use data at time x
$\ln\left(\frac{0.6500}{0.065}\right) = kx$
$\ln 10 = \left(\frac{3\ln 10}{20}\right)x$
$x = \frac{20}{3} = 6.67 = 7\ \mathrm{min}$

questions.stem: In sulphur estimation, $2.0 \times 10^{-3}$ mol of an organic compound (X) (molar mass $76\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$) gave 0.4813 g of barium sulphate (molar mass $233\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$). The percentage of sulphur in the compound (X) is $\underline{\qquad\qquad}$ $\times 10^{-1}$ % (Nearest integer)
questions.solution:
$$\%\ \text{of S} = \frac{\text{Mass of S}}{\text{Mass of BaSO}_4} \times \frac{m}{w} \times 100$$
m = gm of $\mathrm{BaSO_4}$ ppt
w = gm of Organic compound
$w = 2 \times 10^{-3} \times 76 = 0.152\ \mathrm{gm}$
$\%\ \text{of S} = \frac{32}{233} \times \frac{0.4813}{0.152} \times 100 = 43.487$
In form of $10^{-1}$
$= 43.487 \times 10^{-1} = 434.87 \approx 435$
